info.name: PaddyWise-AI (Kumburu) API Tests
info.description:
SE3090 Assignment 2 — API, integration, authorization, agent and security tests for the PaddyWise ASP.NET Core API.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or Newman): later folders use ids saved by earlier ones.
Every run registers fresh users, so it can be repeated against the same database.

Needs: backend running (`dotnet run --launch-profile http`), and an existing Admin account in the environment (adminEmail / adminPassword).
